name: World Trade Organization
body: HSTS is on, framing is limited to the same origin, and DMARC rejects spoofed mail. But the start page has no viewport meta tag, so phones draw the desktop layout zoomed out, and Google indexes mobile first.
lesson: Add a viewport meta tag with width=device-width, initial-scale=1, then test on a phone.
summary: www.wto.org scores 71 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: the start page has no viewport tag.

fix.title: The start page has no viewport tag
fix.evidence: Without it, phones render the desktop layout zoomed out. Google indexes the mobile version first.

fix.title: 6 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /english/news_e/events_e/events_calendar_view_e.htm, /english/news_e/spno_e/spno_e.htm, /english/tratop_e/devel_e/a4t_e/global_review26_e/gr26_programme_e.htm, /english/tratop_e/devel_e/a4t_e/cssta4t_e.htm. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 20 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 8 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /english/news_e/events_e/events_calendar_view_e.htm, /english/res_e/publications_e/world-trade-report-2026_e.htm, /english/res_e/statis_e/hormuz_global_trade_e.htm, /english/res_e/publications_e/anrep-iframe_e.htm and 4 more. Google and AI answers then write…
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /english/res_e/publications_e/global-trade-outlook-and-statistics_e.htm, /english/news_e/news26_e/stat_08oct26_510_e.htm, /english/res_e/statis_e/world_trade_statistics_e.htm and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split…
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.
